text:
Maya: Heads-up — enabling the FP8 inference kernels on the H100 and L40S for the Llama-2-13B bring-up. Saw weird accuracy deltas and a small fraction of NaNs on long-context tests. Anyone else hit this?
Alec: saw something similar yesterday on H100 when switching to the new fuse path. small perplexity bump ~0.6% at seq_len=2048. no NaNs though.
Tariq: L40S run produced token corruption on multi-request batching (KV mismatch between requests). Could be KV cache alignment differences between kernel variants.
Maya: quick repro notes:
```
model: llama-2-13b
runtime: redwood-runtime 2.7.1
cmd: ./serve --model llama-2-13b --quant fp8 --enable-fp8-kernels=true --batcher=continuous --seq_len=2048
flags: export RW_FP8_KERNEL_VARIANT=h100_tn
```
Maya: FWIW we tried both h100_tn and h100_nt kernels. h100_tn had slightly better perf but the NaNs only appeared on h100_nt for one shard config.
Priya: can you paste the NaN stack/log?
Maya: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T16:02:07Z] ERROR inference: produced NaN at layer 23, op matmul_qk, batch 7
[2026-03-14T16:02:07Z] DEBUG kernels: fp8_scale=0.00045, clip_range=6.0, overflow_counter=1
```
Alec: overflow_counter>0 means dynamic scaling hit saturation. FP8 kernels use per-tensor scaling by default; with long sequences activations get larger and we need higher clip_range or bias correction.
Tariq: On L40S I observed a subtle off-by-stride when batch_size>1 and seq_len>1024; KV concat path used a 256-byte alignment that changed memory layout leading to incorrect KV reads in the next request. Repro steps attached.
Maya: That's the bug. When batching multiple requests that later use cache-continue, the kernel assumed packed KV layout. L40S uses different tensor core microtile causing stride assumptions to break.
Priya: Mitigation tried?
Maya: Quick mitigations that helped: 1) disable cross-request KV packing (--batcher=per-request) 2) increase fp8 clip range (--fp8-clip=8.0) 3) run a 20-step warmup before eval to prime dynamic scaling.
Alec: Also tried static per-layer scale calibration (computed from fp16 warm runs) and plugging those into FP8 kernels. Eliminated NaNs entirely and reduced top-1 drop to ~0.15% vs fp16 baseline.
Tariq: Numbers from our benchmark (Llama-2-13B, eval set 5k prompts):
- FP16 baseline: perplexity 12.84, top-1 acc 0.732
- FP8 dynamic scale (default): perplexity 13.01, top-1 acc 0.724 (drop 0.8%)
- FP8 static per-layer: perplexity 12.89, top-1 acc 0.729 (drop 0.3%)
- FP8 + clip_range 8.0 + warmup: perplexity 12.86, top-1 acc 0.731 (drop 0.1%)
Maya: On H100 we also saw that mixed-precision autocast in the runtime caused some ops (small einsums) to be lowered to FP32 while kernels expected FP16->FP8 pathways, which introduced small algorithmic differences and rounding drift across layers. Turning off autocast for attention matmuls made results consistent.
Priya: do we have PRs/flags to expose these knobs? I can add runtime config for: fp8_kernel_variant, fp8_static_scales_path, fp8_clip_range, fp8_warmup_steps, kv_pack_mode.
Maya: yes please. Also add a beware note in the docs: "H100 vs L40S kernel layout differences can cause KV packing incompatibilities across kernel variants".
Alec: important gotcha: when using GPTQ-quantized weights + FP8 compute we saw model-specific calibration shifts. GPTQ's per-channel scales interact with FP8 compute scale heuristics and can amplify rounding error in layernorm pre-hooks.
Tariq: that explains the token corruption for one of the GPTQ builds. We should run a small automated regression: run 500 prompt sanity check that validates KV continuity and token-by-token determinism between fp16 baseline and fp8 path (with static scales).
Maya: Agreed — add to onboarding checklist:
- run short deterministic token check (seed fixed)
- run KV continuity tests on batched repeat/continue
- validate overflow_counter==0 across 1000 tokens
- compare per-layer activation norms to baseline (tolerance 3%)
Priya: infra-bot: can you schedule a bakeoff job on both H100 and L40S with these configs?
infra-bot: Scheduled: bakeoff-1771023456-h100-l40s at 2026-03-14T20:00:00Z. workers: 2x H100, 2x L40S. artifacts: logs + per-layer activations + token diffs.
Alec: One more nuance — memory alignment differences mean our fused attention kernel triggers a different code-path on sequences <128 vs >=128 on L40S. That produced a small perf cliff and small accuracy variance. Suggest we standardize on the >=128 path for repeatability.
Tariq: For production, my recommendation: ship FP8 on H100 only with static calibrated scales + kv_pack_mode=per-request until fix lands for L40S packing. For L40S, keep FP16 default or use FP8 only with static scales and batch_size=1.
Maya: Agreed. I'll open an RFC outlining the rollout plan and include the calibration scripts. Also listing the mitigations and the why.
Priya: add to the console rollout UI a flag to preview "fp8_mode: static" vs "fp8_mode: dynamic" per model revision. That will help SEs test without full infra changes.
Maya: FYI attached mini script we used to compute per-layer static scales:
```python
# sample activations with fp16 baseline and compute max per-layer abs
scales = []
for layer in model.layers:
    acts = collect_activations(layer, inputs_sample)
    max_abs = acts.abs().max()
    scale = max_abs / 127.0  # map to int8-like dynamic range then to fp8 exponent heuristics
    scales.append(scale)
save_json('fp8_scales.json', scales)
```
Alec: nice. We'll add an automated calibrator step to the model onboarding flow.
Maya: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the RFC and link the bakeoff results when infra-bot finishes.
Priya: :thumbsup:
infra-bot: bakeoff completed. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bakeoffs/1771023456/ (perf.csv, token_diffs.tar.gz, activations.tar.gz)
Maya: Received. Initial glance: H100 + static scales = perf win with negligible quality loss. L40S needs the packing fix. I'll tag the eng-runtime and eng-ml owners.
Alec: perfect. postmortem notes: avoid enabling FP8 globally until we have packing parity across kernels and static scale calibrator in the pipeline.
Tariq: logging action items:
- [T1] fix KV packing stride on L40S kernels (assigned Tariq)
- [T2] add fp8_static_scales export in onboarding (Priya)
- [T3] add deterministic token tests in CI (Alec)
- [T4] doc + console flags (Maya)
Maya: I'll create the RFC and link the ticket numbers. Thanks!"
